newsitem.title: USA: Glickman sees China making concessions for WTO.
newsitem.headline: Glickman sees China making concessions for WTO.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman said he believed China would make concessions to gain entry to the World Trade Organization.
"My judgement is that they will ultimately see they're going to have to make those responsible concessions..." Glickman told a House Agriculture Committee hearing.
"We just can't accept them under the current circumstances. We have to pressure them to be an equal member," he added.
The U.S. has been pressing China to get rid of state-run trading monopolies and remove a number of barriers to U.S. farm exports including wheat.
